div_boundary_F24.notes: Window runs past trace end -> activates boundary (clamp vs pessimistic).

div_terminal_and.notes: Top-level and violated only at final sample -> activates terminal (extend_penultimate).

interp_window.notes: Window [t+0.5,t+1.5] covers a sample at each anchor on a uniform grid -> separates signal models (pl_interp vs pl_samples vs zoh; non-integer bounds make discrete raise). Unlike div_interp_sparse, the window is NOT empty, so it avoids Breach's mixed window-endpoint fallback (the documented exp-1 factorization gap that no generic config reproduces).

div_nonuniform_always.notes: Non-uniform grid -> discrete model reads index semantics / rejects, separating signal models.

div_equality.notes: Equality predicate -> activates equality (signed vs bigm vs epsilon) and the euclidean-vs-signed predicate path.

until_window.notes: Bounded until on a uniform 5-sample grid -> activates until_prefix (inclusive vs exclusive) and discrete boundary.

multivar_affine.notes: Multi-variable affine predicate (||A||=sqrt(2)) -> activates predicate (signed vs euclidean normalization).
